KISWAHILI — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina.

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
